final: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration <> 0 GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM r WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_ratio, r.avg_ratio - m.overall AS above_overall FROM r, m WHERE m.overall IS NOT NULL AND r.avg_ratio > m.overall ORDER BY r.rating
